nodes.title: START HERE
widgets_values:
# UPSCALE + RTX 4K – MiniMax H3
Your approved shot in, the same shot in **true 4K** out: H3 re-draws it at 1536p with the same prompt and references (group 6), then NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution brings it to 3840×2160 (group 7).

1. **Models** (group 1): download links are in the notes on the left.
2. **Settings** (group 3): **NAME** = output folder · **Seed** = the fine detail · **TURBO?** on = 4 fast re-draw steps, off = 13 steps of the official schedule (~3× slower).
3. **Prompt** (4a): the shot's own STYLE, WORLD and THIS SHOT. Drag its `_workflow.png` into ComfyUI and copy the boxes from there.
4. **REF IMAGE 1–4** (4b): the shot's references in the same slots. Bypass the empty ones (**Ctrl+B**).
5. **YOUR CLIP** (4d): the approved shot.
6. **RTX 4K?** (SWITCHES, group 3): on = the 4K step runs (RTX GPU needed), off = 1536p only.
7. Run.

**Output:** `output/AnimeH3/Upscale/NAME/`: `NAME_up_00001.mp4` (H.264 CRF 15, with the clip's sound), `NAME_up_workflow_00001.png`. Short side 1536: 2688×1536 from a Draft or Final, 1536×1536 from a square turnaround. With RTX 4K on, also `NAME_up_4K_00001.mp4`, 3840×2160 (ULTRA ×1.43 + centre fill-crop; best for 16:9 shots).

**Watch out**
* Upscale the clip you approved instead of re-rendering it: a re-render changes the performance.
* Out of memory on 16 GB: **chunk length** 34 (on **UPSCALE · H3 re-draw**, group 6).

**Needs** ComfyUI 0.37.0 or newer + [KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes), [Mickmumpitz Nodes](https://github.com/mickmumpitz/ComfyUI-Mickmumpitz-Nodes), [rgthree](https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy), [MMH3 Ultimate Upscale](https://github.com/bbaudio-2025/Comfyui-MMH3-UltimateUpscale), [NVIDIA RTX nodes 0.2.1](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_Nvidia_VFX_Nodes) (`nvidia-vfx` ≥ 0.2, an RTX GPU, driver ≥ 570.65). Red nodes: *Missing Node Packs* → **Install All** → restart.

nodes.title: STYLE
widgets_values: 2D anime screencap, flat cel-shaded illustration, hand-drawn manga-style ink line art. Late-1990s Japanese street-racing anime style, dramatic high-contrast look, with a retro, slightly rough hand-inked feel: heavier black ink contour weight, faint pen-line wobble as if inked by hand frame by frame, a light halftone-dot shading pattern layered into the darkest shadow shapes, subtle scan-line grain across the frame, warm slightly desaturated retro color grading. Flat solid color fills with strong, clearly separated cel-shading — one hard-edged core shadow tone and a brighter secondary highlight tone per surface. A clean picture: the frame shows only the scene.

nodes.title: WORLD
widgets_values: The street on the outskirts of Shibuwaka, a small town in rural Japan, at clear midday: small shops with plain flat color signboards, a row of brightly colored drink vending machines, trimmed hedges, pastel apartment blocks with laundry-hung balconies, and utility poles with dense black cables sagging across a flat hazy pale sky. Daylight falls as hard-edged flat shadow shapes, with crisp flat highlights on painted metal and glass.

nodes.title: RTX 4K · requirements
widgets_values:
## True 4K with NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution
The H3 upscale (group 6, 1536p) is brought to **3840×2160**: RTX VSR **ULTRA** ×1.43, then a centre fill-crop to exactly 16:9 (the 1536p clip is a little wider than 16:9). Frames, sound and fps are taken from the H3 result.

**Needs:** an NVIDIA **RTX** GPU · driver **≥ 570.65** · custom nodes **comfyui_nvidia_rtx_nodes 0.2.1** with **nvidia-vfx ≥ 0.2** (`pip install nvidia-vfx --extra-index-url https://pypi.nvidia.com`).

No RTX card? Switch **RTX 4K?** off (group 3): you keep the 1536p result of group 6.
